deviations.what: The three Image srcs read {img>/products/pic1} from the named img model (ui5/mock/img.json); the single value is folded into the view - the mock's own HT-7777-large.jpg, re-hosted on sdk.openui5.org, so the Images render identically.

onInit seeds /widthS /widthM /widthL from Device.system.phone (2em/4em/6em on a phone, 5em/10em/15em otherwise) and the view binds them. The port expresses the same branch over the framework's device> model in an expression binding on each Image width, so the widths stay device-dependent instead of being resolved once on the server (app 031 precedent).
